svg.aria-label: Receptionist press: an incoming phone call rides a punched tape into the Tell-1 voice-model drum, which hears the caller in 72ms; the routing switchboard routes the call; the n8n webhook gear fires the automation; the stamp press stamps the appointment and the CRM booking drum files it, dropping the booked ticket into the out-tray. The numbers are the ones from the story: $100M ARR, $4.6M raised, 72ms to the first chunk, $0.035 per minute, 100M calls a month, 4,000 businesses.
svg.text: $100M ARR · $4.6M RAISED · 72MS FIRST CHUNK · $0.035/MIN · 100M CALLS/MO · 4,000 BUSINESSES
